explanation: The December 2017 document contains a rate hike (fed funds target raised to 1-1/4 to 1-1/2 percent) and an acceleration in balance sheet runoff caps effective January (Treasury cap doubling from $6B to $12B, MBS cap doubling from $4B to $8B), both of which are substantive policy actions that could plausibly drive a structural break in financial market data around early January 2018 as the new reinvestment caps took effect.
